Includes Pork Pau x 4 pcs, Char Siew Pau x 10 pcs, Lotus paste Pau 3pcs,  Red Bean Pau x 3 pcs, 12 Siew Mai, 1 Fan Choy, 1 Glutinous Chicken Rice.
